featured_reviews.name: Unmesh Zagade
featured_reviews.review_text:
Matushri Velbai Sabhagruha is a Community Center and a Multipurpose Hall located at  Chandavarkar Road, Matunga(CR), Matunga East, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400019. It is located nearby Central Matunga Railway Station in Mumbai. The very famous Ramashraya and Madras Cafe are very near to it. The Jain community uses it as a community hall for their functions.

This Banquet hall has a dining area on the ground floor and main multi purpose hall on the first floor. The lift facility is not available. The hall has a centralized Air conditioning system. There is no monopoly in catering. We are allowed to have our own caterers for our functions. The food quality is good.

The hall is very small and not spacious. It can accommodate 100-200 guests at a time. This is recommended only for small functions and weddings. The decoration choices are also within the budget. The restrooms are well maintained and clean. In terms of rent of the hall, it is considered as expensive compared to other options available in the nearby area.

The parking is not available on the premises. You can park on the road also at your own risk.

Nearest Railway Station - Central Matunga Railway Station

Nearest Metro Station - There is no Metro Service available as of now.
